nodes.label: Diem 2013 Theorem 2: e^(O(max(log q, n sqrt(log q), n^(3/2))))
nodes.statement: ECDLP in E(F_{q^n}) can be solved in expected time e^(O(max(log q, n (log q)^(1/2), n^(3/2)))).
